thread:
tyler: Heads up — the Go generator sample app is leaking goroutines when you cancel the context. Repro in sample-app/generator/main.go: canceling ctx doesn't close the underlying stream, goroutines pile up.

sara: Ack. Any stack traces or minimal repro?

tyler: Minimal snippet I threw together:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
g := client.Generator(ctx, req)
// read one token then cancel
_ = g.Next()
cancel()
// expect g.Next() to return quickly, but goroutine hangs reading from net.Conn
```

michael: This sounds like the retry/auth wrapper might be swallowing context cancellations. If the retry loop calls the generator factory again on ctx.Err() == nil it could hold references. We've seen similar with streaming embeddings.

denise: Also hitting onboarding friction: our quickstart shows `client.Generator(ctx, req)` but nowhere do we show best-practices for canceling or scheduling Close(). New users copy paste and run into this.

sam: Proposal: make generator take a background context for lifecycle and then require an explicit `g.Close()` (idempotent) so cancellation is explicit. Or accept ctx on `Next(ctx)` so callers can cancel per-read. Which is more ergonomic?

maddy: Prefer `Next(ctx)` pattern for per-read timeouts, plus a `Close()` for cleanup. That mirrors Go io.Reader patterns. Also we should return a sentinel error like `ErrGeneratorClosed` and avoid exposing internal `context.Canceled` to the user.

tyler: I can open a PR in the sample app to patch the example to `defer g.Close()` and add a note on `Next(ctx)`. I'll also add a small test that cancels early. Putting up an issue for SDK API discussion first. cc @maddy @sam

michael: One more gotcha: auth token renewal triggers a reconnect path which currently doesn't propagate cancellation to the old stream — lazy cleanup. We should ensure reconnect cancels old readers.

denise: For docs: add a short section "Streaming generators: cancellation patterns" with examples for context cancel, per-read timeout, and Close(). Keep it under Quickstart and Generator reference.

tyler: Created issue #2345: "go sdk generator ctx leak / sample-app fix" with repro and suggested changes. Will draft PR after initial API decision.

dev-bot: Issue #2345 created by tyler: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/2345 : raised severity P2

sara: Thanks — small follow-up: can we add an FAQ entry about "why my app keeps running after cancel"? It's a top confusion point from support.

maddy: Good call. I'll take the docs PR once the API is settled. Also will loop in eng-runtime to verify server reconnect semantics.

sam: OK, action items: tyler -> open sample-app PR (patch example + test), maddy -> docs PR once API decided, michael -> investigate retry/auth wrapper and reconnect cancellation, denise -> add Quickstart note request.

tyler: I'll post PR link here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
